accessNotes: The Supernova docs site redirects to satisfied-anaconda-cyan.supernova-docs.io; pages are server-rendered HTML and were read with curl. All Data Visualization pages (overview, chart selection, colour, bar/line/plot/part-to-whole/other guidelines) plus Foundations > Typography were read. Example images are hosted on studio-assets.supernova.io. The guide gives colour tokens and do/don't rules but no explicit chart-level pixel specs (gridline colour, axis widths, chart title sizes); those are described from the example images only.
summary: Kraft Heinz's internal 'Delish' enterprise design system for analytics products (Tableau, Power BI, React dashboards). Charts are clean business-dashboard style in Segoe UI: a cobalt blue lead colour, gray for de-emphasis, light horizontal gridlines with a darker baseline, few gridlines at logical increments, sorted bars, and highlight-one-in-colour/rest-gray storytelling.

colors.categoricalNotes: Core data-viz palette in documented order: Blue #295cad, Gray #a2aeb5, Red #b94431, Teal #05a3b1, Ocean #0b3873, Green #529c74, Yellow #df9f37. Use one colour for bars showing the same categorical data; use gray to de-emphasise. Pie charts max 4–5 segments; line charts up to 4 lines, never more than 6.
colors.notes: Semantic on light backgrounds: Positive #529c74, Negative #b94431, Notice #df9f37. Semantic on dark backgrounds: Positive #37bb65, Negative #cc2e48, Notice #df9f37. Sequential 4-step ramps (dark→light): Blue #133a77 #295cad #6f94ce #9ebbe6; Gray #36383a #646b6f #a2aeb5 #d1dbe2; Red #460f05 #8c2e20 #b94431 #cf8a7e; Teal #063f44 #136a73 #05a3b1 #80d0d7; Ocean #071e39 #0b3873 #5a74cb #9ab2ff; Green #08362a #1d6953 #529c74 #87c3a9; Yellow #563b10 #a06a14 #df9f37 #ffd592. No diverging palette is documented.

typography.notes: Product type scale (Segoe UI, 5 weights): caption2 10/14px, caption1 12/16px, body1 14/22px, body2 16/24px, title4 20/28px, title3 24/34px, title1Stronger 32/48 bold, display 40–52px. Chart-specific sizes are not stated; example charts use small regular gray Segoe UI tick labels and legends.

structure.gridlines: Horizontal only, light gray, few and at logical increments (e.g. 0/10/20/30, not 0/6/12/18/24/30); 'Provide enough gridlines … Don't overcrowd'. Use gridlines OR direct labels on bar charts, not both.
structure.axisLine: Always draw the baseline: x-axis line on column charts, y-axis line on horizontal bar charts ('Don't let the columns or bars float'); examples show a darker gray baseline than the gridlines.
structure.zeroLine: Bars/columns always start at zero; zero baseline drawn as a darker line.
structure.frame: Charts sit in light-gray (#f7f7f7-ish) rounded cards in the doc examples; no plot border.

legend.placement: top-left above the plot in examples (horizontal row)
legend.directLabels: Direct labels allowed instead of gridlines; legend required for forecast dashed lines.
legend.title: Not shown in examples.

marks.bars: Sorted greatest-to-least (or reverse) unless a natural order exists; single colour for one categorical series; time on vertical columns (if horizontal, most recent at top); square corners, bar width > gap in examples.
marks.lines: Medium-thick lines that stand out from gridlines but show detail; ≤4 lines (never >6), else small multiples; circular markers at points in examples; forecasts as dashed line in same colour (with legend entry) or lighter shade or shaded/labelled background.
marks.areas: Area charts emphasise magnitude; radar shapes use transparency.
marks.points: Transparent dots with outlines for overlapping points; bubbles only when size differences are large and the metric is positive; dumbbells with 2 (max 3) dots.
marks.pies: Allowed; must include all parts summing to 100%; max 4–5 segments; highlight one segment in colour and others in shades of gray; avoid pies for comparing wholes.
marks.notes: Map outlines kept light like gridlines; timelines read left to right.

labels.dataLabels: Either gridlines or direct value labels, not both. Stacked/ribbon examples show white labels inside segments.

furniture.other: Less familiar chart types carry a 'Consider other chart types before using' label in the docs.

annotations: Forecast periods via dashed line or shaded, labelled background; timelines heavily annotated.
interaction: Charts built in Tableau/Power BI/React; guidance on interactions offered via office hours but not documented.
accessibility: Easily differentiable colours for pie wedges especially with legends; links to WebAIM/colour-accessibility resources; separate semantic colours for dark backgrounds.

chartTypes.notes: 'Discouraged' here = types flagged 'Consider other chart types before using' (book office hours). Single box plot discouraged; spaghetti charts discouraged.

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical order: Blue #295cad, Gray #a2aeb5, Red #b94431, Teal #05a3b1, Ocean #0b3873, Green #529c74, Yellow #df9f37.
distinctiveRules.quote: Colors / Data viz / Core #295cad Blue #a2aeb5 Gray #b94431 Red …

distinctiveRules.rule: Highlight the key bar/line/slice in colour (blue) and render the rest gray.
distinctiveRules.quote: Gray can be used to deemphasize lines that are shown for context

distinctiveRules.rule: Bar charts use gridlines or direct value labels — never both.
distinctiveRules.quote: Gridlines or direct labels. Use one or the other, you generally don't need both.

distinctiveRules.rule: Always draw a baseline axis line (x for columns, y for horizontal bars); bars start at zero.
distinctiveRules.quote: Don't let the columns or bars float without the clearly defined baseline.

distinctiveRules.rule: Few horizontal gridlines at round increments (≈3–4 lines), light gray, with darker zero baseline.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use logical increments. Don't overcrowd the chart with more gridlines than necessary

distinctiveRules.rule: Bars sorted by value; time series as vertical columns, or most-recent-at-top if horizontal.
distinctiveRules.quote: Sort, sort, sort! … start with the most recent data point at the top.

distinctiveRules.rule: Max 4 lines per chart (hard limit 6), otherwise small multiples.
distinctiveRules.quote: only include up to 4 lines in a single chart. Try to never use more than 6 lines.

distinctiveRules.rule: Forecast data drawn as dashed line in the same colour, with a legend entry.
distinctiveRules.quote: use a dashed line in the same color as the past data. Make sure to add a legend entry

distinctiveRules.rule: Pies: 4–5 segments max, sum to 100%, one highlighted segment with gray shades for the rest.
distinctiveRules.quote: try not to use more than 4 or 5 segments … shades of gray are a good choice for less important segments

distinctiveRules.rule: Overlapping points drawn as transparent dots with outlines.
distinctiveRules.quote: use transparent dots with outlines rather than solid dots

distinctiveRules.rule: Semantic positive/negative/notice colours switch for dark backgrounds (#37bb65/#cc2e48/#df9f37 vs #529c74/#b94431/#df9f37).
distinctiveRules.quote: Colors / Data viz / Semantic / Dark bkgd #37bb65 Positive #cc2e48 Negative

distinctiveRules.rule: All chart text in Segoe UI (product font).
distinctiveRules.quote: Across our digital products, we use the font Segoe UI

referenceImages.describes: Do/Don't line chart pair on light-gray rounded cards. 'Do': two thick lines (cobalt blue #295cad and amber #df9f37) with filled circle markers; only three light-gray horizontal gridlines at 10/20/30 plus a darker charcoal baseline at 0; y tick labels in regular gray Segoe UI to the left, no tick marks, no axis titles, no y-axis line. 'Don't': same data with gridlines every 3 units (too many).

Do/Don't column chart: four cobalt-blue square-cornered columns, bar width wider than gaps. 'Do' has a thin dark-gray x baseline; 'Don't' shows columns floating with no baseline. No gridlines, labels or titles; light-gray card background.

Ribbon chart thumbnail: legend at top-left with small circle swatches (blue, light gray, dark gray) labelled 'Label'; light horizontal gridlines with '#$' tick labels at left; stacked columns in cobalt blue, slate gray and light gray with white '$%' labels inside segments, connected by translucent ribbons; category labels below. Segoe UI, small gray text.
